type.korean_family_fallback: Noto Sans KR, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Malgun Gothic, sans-serif
type.monospace_banned: IBM Plex Mono / JetBrains Mono / Courier — strictly FORBIDDEN. No tabular numerals. No English wordmark line.

cover_title.treatment: Center-positioned navy black weight Korean title. NO yellow highlight (lavender signature stays in body eyebrow only).

section_divider_h1.treatment: On full-bleed photo + lavender #BCC4F2 alpha 0.65 veil overlay. NO giant 96pt roman numeral — only small outline pill 'Ⅰ 10대 핵심과제' at top-left.

page_eyebrow.treatment: MANDATORY left-side lavender #7285E4 small dot (diameter ~6px) or short bar (12px×3px) prefix. Format: '지난 6개월간 성과' '문화체육관광부 업무보고' '10대 핵심과제 N'.

outline_pill_section_label.treatment: Rounded fully-pill (radius 999px) with 1.5pt navy outline + transparent fill + navy text. Format: '6 문화창조산업 성장엔진 가속화' '09 K-컬처 활용 방한관광 활성화'. Padding x 3% y 1%.

page_h1_hero.treatment: One core message per slide. Examples: 'K-컬처가 新성장동력이 되다' 'K-관광, 3천만 조기 달성'.

card_header_pill.treatment: Fully rounded navy pill header on every card (2-up / 3-up / 4-up). White bold Korean centered. NO border, NO shadow, NO gradient on pill. Single anatomy across all card pages.

card_body_lead.treatment: First emphasis line inside card body. Followed by dashed divider then muted detail rows.

matrix_quadrant_label.treatment: Each 2x2 matrix quadrant. White bold on violet/lavender-dark fills, navy bold on lavender-pastel fills.

number_badge_large.treatment: Large numbers ⑥⑦⑧⑨⑩ on p-09/p-11 style pages, left-aligned next to navy heading.

number_badge_small.treatment: Small numbers ①~⑩ for p-07 agenda right-side list.

kculture_brown_pill_label.treatment: Central brown pill 'K-컬처 산업' on p-13 industry-tree diagram. SIGNATURE — used only on diagram page center label and K-컬처 illustration tone.

inner_navy_pill_3col.treatment: Three inline navy pills inside '문화창조 산업' outline box on p-13. Labels: 콘텐츠 / 문화 / 예술.

chevron_arrow_bullet.shape: two-V-stacked chevron (▶▶ or >> glyph or SVG path)
chevron_arrow_bullet.position: left-aligned, body text right of chevron
chevron_arrow_bullet.treatment: MANDATORY on narrative pages (p04/p19/p21/p22/p24 style). REPLACES ●▶■ generic bullets. 4-5 lines per page typical.

chart_value_label.treatment: Direct labeling next to each data point on p-20 line chart. NO legend box. Tabular monospace BANNED.

x2_marker_text.treatment: Two X2 markers between KR and JP lines at '24 and '30 positions. Red rectangles with white bold X2 text.

cta_button_text.treatment: Red CTA pill button on p-20. Example: '관광 정책 컨트롤 타워 강화'. Accompanied by red ↑ arrow above body.

page_caption_footer.page_indicator: NONE — this deck does not display page numbers in footer

shape.border_default: none on card body (use micro-shadow only). 1.5pt #32355D outline ONLY on outline pills and diagram container.
shape.shadow_glow_blur: FORBIDDEN — no drop shadow heavy, no glow effects, no blur
shape.gradient_allowed: ONLY on cover sweep BG and chart future-zone yellow fill (which is solid alpha, not gradient). NO gradient on pills, cards, headers, CTA buttons.

background_modes.body_standard: Full #EEF2F7 page bg + header zone (4.5-11%) with left lavender-dot eyebrow + tiny right emblem + 1px #C8E1EE rule line + H1 zone (13-26%) + main content (28-88%) + corner dot pattern footer (88-96%). NO page indicator.
background_modes.cover: Full #E7EDF5 cool grey + left-right asymmetric sweep gradient curves + center navy H1 + government emblem above H1 + corner dot patterns (1-2 #DB0725 red accent dots).
background_modes.section_divider: Full-bleed K-culture photo + #BCC4F2 lavender solid veil alpha 0.65 + top-left outline pill 'Ⅰ 10대 핵심과제' + center/bottom-left white black-weight H1 52pt. NO header bar, NO footer bar.
background_modes.split_photo: Left 50% #E5ECF4 cool grey BG with navy headline + small emblem bottom-left + Right 50% full-bleed K-culture photo (no overlay). Used on cover-secondary p-02 style and closing p-25 style.

header_zone.content: left eyebrow with lavender dot/bar + right top emblem (1.5%×3%) + bottom 1px #C8E1EE accent rule
header_zone.lavender_indicator: MANDATORY left-side lavender #7285E4 small dot (6px) or short bar (12px×3px) prefix to eyebrow text

footer_zone.content: corner dot pattern decoration only (8x6 or 6x4 grid, #BAD7E7 with optional #DB0725 accent dot)
footer_zone.wordmark: NONE — no English wordmark line, no MCST 2026 ANNUAL POLICY BRIEF style

chart.signature: p-20 K-관광 3천만 single-page integrated chart — KR navy solid line + JP red dashed line + yellow future-zone fill + X2 red markers + KPI card right + red CTA button. Five elements combined.
chart.data_encoding: Two distinct lines per chart panel, one solid navy, one dashed red. NO rainbow series within single panel.
chart.x2_markers: two red #E33D3C small rectangles at x='24 and x='30 between KR-JP lines with white bold 'X2' text
chart.gridline: NONE — no grid, no chart border box
chart.value_label: direct label next to each point, Pretendard Bold 14pt, KR labels navy / JP labels red. NO tabular monospace.
chart.types_allowed: Line chart + future-zone fill + X2 markers (SIGNATURE). Photo cluster grids. Industry-tree diagram. 2x2 matrix.
chart.types_forbidden: donut, pie, 3D, treemap, rainbow series, dual-axis, 100% stacked horizontal bar, pair-chart split, tabular monospace labels

diagram.kit_a_matrix_2x2_plus_list: p-07 = p02-agenda — Left 60% 2x2 matrix (K-컬처/문화창조/동반성장/토대구축 four quadrants, each rounded radius 12px with white or navy bold 22pt category label) + Right 40% ①~⑩ numbered list with small navy outline circle badges. SIGNATURE.
diagram.kit_b_industry_tree: p-13 = p06-diagram — Central K-컬처 brown pill (#8F6F56 fill, white 24pt 'K-컬처 산업') + Left outline navy box containing 3 inline navy pills (콘텐츠/문화/예술) + Right 3 flat human illustrations (Made With Korea / K-브랜드 호감도 / 소비재 수출). Container = 1.5pt navy rounded outline radius 16px. SIGNATURE.
diagram.kit_c_navy_pill_cards: p-03/p-04/p-05/p-06/p-10/p-11/p-15/p-16/p-23/p-24 = p07-cards/p08-comparison — Single anatomy: rounded 999px navy pill header (white 20pt) + white body box radius 8px with dashed #DDE2EE 1px internal divider + navy bold 17pt lead + muted 14pt detail rows. 2-up / 3-up / 4-up grids. THE workhorse module.
diagram.kit_d_chevron_narrative: p-19/p-21/p-22/p-04 = p09-narrative — Left 55% four-five ▶▶ chevron-arrow lines (navy #32355D 22pt double-V + navy bold 18pt message text) + Right 45% companion visual (world-map dot network #67A0A6 / illustration / photo / phone mockup). SIGNATURE.
diagram.kit_e_chart_kpi_cta: p-20 = p05-chart — see chart.signature. Five elements: line chart + future zone + X2 markers + KPI card + red CTA button.
diagram.lavender_indicator_signature: MANDATORY top-left eyebrow lavender #7285E4 dot/bar on every body page. Pack identity rule — if missing, slide fails QA.
diagram.section_divider_veil: MANDATORY full-bleed K-culture photo + #BCC4F2 alpha 0.65 lavender veil on every Ⅰ~Ⅳ section divider. Four occurrences (one per section).
diagram.render: SVG/PPT shapes — no div blocks, no anti-aliased fallback, micro shadows OK on card body, gradients allowed only on cover sweep BG (NOT on pills/cards/CTA)

slide.transition: instant cut or soft fade 150-200ms. No bounce, zoom, rotation, flip. Static visual identity from lavender dot + navy pill + dashed divider + chevron arrows + photo+veil dividers.

pages.label: 핵심 메시지 (좌 텍스트 + 우 실사 split)
종결 (좌 마감 카피 + 우 실사 + 엠블럼)
